cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException with message "name must not be null"
cases.description: Passing a null Name should trigger validation and throw IllegalArgumentException before any other processing.
An invalid DNS type (negative value) must be rejected by Type.check, causing the method to throw IllegalArgumentException.
When the underlying findRRsetWithoutLock returns null (no matching RRset), findExactMatch should return null.

cases.expected: RRset instance that is equal in content to the original but not the same reference
cases.description: When a matching RRset exists, findExactMatch must return a defensive copy (new RRset(set)). The copy should contain the same records as the original, but modifying the original after the call must not affect the returned copy.

cases.expected: RRset instance equal in content to the original but a different reference (case‑insensitive name lookup)
cases.description: Zone stores an A RRset under a lower‑case name ("host.example.com."). Querying with a mixed‑case Name should succeed because DNS names are case‑insensitive, and the method must still return a defensive copy.
Type value 0 is not a valid DNS RR type; Type.check should reject it and the method must propagate the IllegalArgumentException.
The ANY type (255) is allowed by Type.check, but findExactMatch looks for an exact type match. Since no RRset is stored under type ANY, the method should return null.

cases.expected: RRset copy that remains unchanged after the original RRset is mutated
cases.description: After obtaining the exact match, add an additional record to the original RRset stored in the Zone. The RRset returned by findExactMatch must be a defensive copy, so its contents must stay the same while the original changes.
The Zone contains an A RRset for the name but no AAAA RRset. Requesting a different, valid type should result in null, confirming that the method does not return unrelated RRsets.

cases.expected: RRset instance that is a copy of the stored SOA RRset
cases.description: Verify that findExactMatch works for the special SOA type, returning a copy of the SOA RRset rather than the original instance.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException thrown by Type.check(int) because type exceeds the maximum valid DNS type (65535)
cases.description: A type value greater than the highest defined DNS RR type should be rejected by Type.check, causing findExactMatch to throw IllegalArgumentException.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException thrown by Type.check(int) because type is out of the valid range
cases.description: Using Integer.MAX_VALUE as the type parameter tests the upper bound validation of Type.check; the method must propagate the IllegalArgumentException.
